```lean
import Data.Finset

theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (2 * i + 1) = (n + 1) ^ 2 := by
  let k := n + 1
  have h1 : ∑ i in Finset.range k, (2 * i + 1) = k ^ 2 :=
    by induction k with k ih; [refl, rw [Finset.range_succ, Finset.sum_union, Finset.sum_range_add],
      rw [ih], rw [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.pow_succ], rw [Nat.add_left_comm], rw [Nat.add_assoc]]
  rw [h1]
```
